methodology: Targeted search of original vendor/repository/docs; not an exhaustive census or instrumented benchmark; feature claims not independently verified.
market_position: DELIA is an experimental project; no superiority, fully unique position or paying customers verified.
proposed_wedge: DELIA ContractOps for Integrators: vendor-neutral business process conformance kits across existing gateways + tenant-aware templates + independent outcome assurance + transparent cost/installation evidence; HYPOTHESIS not shipped.

proof_required.test: Same CRM tool contract executes as a deny/approve/allow fixture across at least two independent vendor adapters, not just in-memory mock.
Second tenant policy setup hours and false blocks vs configured Helio/OPA/AgentTrustOps and buyer's actual baseline.
Unknown outcome never mapped to success with authentic sandbox system-of-record read-back and durable idempotency.
5 qualified buyer conversations with documented alternative, budget and current cost.
At least one paid discovery workshop or an explicit no-fit/pivot decision; must be booked and collected in financial records.

competitors.name: AgentTrustOps
competitors.documented_overlaps: Bound approvals, idempotency, reconciliation, signed offline evidence and tested adapters are described; some capabilities are still early-stage.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Do not claim novelty for commit-point transaction or reconciliation.

competitors.name: Pruvz
competitors.documented_overlaps: Independent read-back, policy snapshots, evidence proofs and Stripe/HubSpot test integrations are claimed by the vendor.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Outcome verification and signed evidence already have direct competition.

competitors.name: ACPT
competitors.documented_overlaps: Outcome contracts, run reconstruction, authoritative comparison and policy evaluation are described; roadmap separates current/next/later.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Outcome assurance is not a unique DELIA invention.

competitors.name: NIA AI Harness
competitors.documented_overlaps: Independent evaluators, permission budgets and evidence attestations are described.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Budget+independent verdicts+evidence overlap.

competitors.name: Helio
competitors.documented_overlaps: MCP proxy with approvals, prereqs, evidence, durable budgets, kill switch and audit, plus professional review offering.
competitors.commercial_consequence: MCP governance, cumulative budget and paid deployment review not unique.

competitors.name: Preloop
competitors.documented_overlaps: Open source agent firewall, model gateway, policy approvals, observability, cost analytics and evidence packs.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Avoid broad all-in-one firewall positioning.

competitors.name: Gravitee
competitors.documented_overlaps: LLM, MCP and A2A governance under common auth, policy and observability.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Gateway breadth not a viable early differentiator.

competitors.name: ServiceNow AI Passport
competitors.documented_overlaps: Authority credential and central governance with spend-to-outcomes reporting announced October 2026.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Large incumbents compete on delegated authority, traceability and business metrics.

competitors.name: Beyryl
competitors.documented_overlaps: MSP multi-tenant governance, white label, onboarding templates and usage views described in listing.
competitors.commercial_consequence: B2B2B and multi-tenant/white label not unique.

competitors.name: AIRA by CinderLabs
competitors.documented_overlaps: White-label evidence reports, client tenant portal and recurring-revenue program described.
competitors.commercial_consequence: MSP go-to-market is established elsewhere.

competitors.name: Runlayer
competitors.documented_overlaps: MCP control, activity history, real-time policies, costs and ROI visibility described.
competitors.commercial_consequence: No unique claim for ROI and policy control.

competitors.name: Check Point AI Agent Security
competitors.documented_overlaps: Agent inventory posture risk, runtime guardrails including DLP and tool responses; early access noted.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Agent posture+runtime DLP already supplied by major vendors.

competitors.name: Promptfoo
competitors.documented_overlaps: Open tooling for red-team and guardrail tests; explicit distinction between detection and enforcement.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Evaluation as a category is established; differentiate by process economics.

competitors.name: PrivAiTe
competitors.documented_overlaps: Privacy proxy claims structured tool arguments and reversible PII masking.
competitors.commercial_consequence: PII filtering and tool argument redaction not unique.

competitors.name: agentgateway
competitors.documented_overlaps: Open agent, MCP and LLM data plane, authentication and observability.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Prefer interoperable adapters over gateway rewrite.

competitors.name: Microsoft Agent 365
competitors.documented_overlaps: Agent governance templates to limit policy drift between deployments.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Policy templates and drift are not unique.

competitors.name: OWASP Agent Control Standard
competitors.documented_overlaps: Portable agent control hooks and policy enforcement standard is published.
competitors.commercial_consequence: DELIA should interoperate; no proprietary standard-first claim.

competitors.name: NIST AI Agent Standards Initiative
competitors.documented_overlaps: Industry standards, identity and interoperability initiative.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Standards compliance requires actual implementation and validation.

competitors.name: Temporal
competitors.documented_overlaps: Durable workflows and recovery with human interaction patterns.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Do not reinvent durable schedulers before economic justification.

competitors.name: Cerbos
competitors.documented_overlaps: Authorization via policy and gateway integration.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Don't reinvent enterprise authorization policy engines.

competitors.name: Open Policy Agent
competitors.documented_overlaps: Declarative policy-as-code decision engine.
competitors.commercial_consequence: Build portable business contracts as complementary layer.

competitors.name: Salesforce Agentforce
competitors.documented_overlaps: Agent architecture includes CRM actions, policy guardrails and human intervention.
competitors.commercial_consequence: CRM-native rules and action controls already exist.
